overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing colonist psychology state transitions for zero-allocation updates, and establishing a compact tick-based event log for endgame analysis.

tasks.title: Deterministic State Hashing for Save/Load Integrity
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a FNV-1a 64-bit hash function for core state structs. Use constexpr where possible. No dynamic allocation. Hash inputs: tick count, colonist count, resource totals. Output: uint64_t. Integrate into SaveSystem::Serialize and LoadSystem::Deserialize for checksum validation.
acceptance_criteria: Checksum mismatch triggers immediate load failure with error code.
Unit tests verify hash stability across 1000 random state permutations.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures save files are never corrupted, providing reliable resume functionality.

tasks.title: Zero-Allocation Colonist Psychology State Machine
tasks.architectural_spec: Replace std::vector-based state history with a fixed-size circular buffer (size 16) for recent psychological states. Use enum class for states (Idle, Working, Resting, Panicked). Implement transition logic using switch-case for O(1) updates. No virtual functions.
acceptance_criteria: Memory footprint per colonist reduced by 40%.
No dynamic memory allocation during tick updates.
All 16,500 logged footsteps reproduce identical state sequences.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster simulation ticks, allowing more complex worlds without lag.

tasks.title: Compact Tick-Based Event Log for Endgame Analysis
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a bit-packed event log for the last 1000 ticks. Each event is 32 bits: 16-bit tick, 8-bit event type, 8-bit value. Use std::array<uint32_t, 1000>. Provide iterator for sequential access. No string storage; use enum indices for event types.
acceptance_criteria: Event retrieval is O(1) via index.
Log correctly records all 5,500 ticks with no overflow errors.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Enables detailed post-game analysis and debugging of simulation behavior.
